comparator.name: International Bachelor in Psychology
comparator.sourceNotes: The current English programme overview and 2026–2027 EER establish a broad common Psychology curriculum followed by one of four formal specialisations. This coherent 180-EC pathway instantiates Brain and Cognition because it most directly continues the common cognitive and biological psychology core rather than selecting an applied specialisation; the 15-EC minor and 10-EC psychology elective space remain open.

alternatives.label: Closest match to Psychology
alternatives.concept: A broad closest feasible psychology programme combining social, developmental, clinical, cognitive and organisational psychology with statistics, research methods, assessment-related study and cross-disciplinary perspectives on behaviour.
progression: The sociology sequence progresses from Introduction through Modern Sociology to Contemporary Social Theory; advanced psychology follows the psychology gateway and statistics.

alternatives.label: Brain & cognition
alternatives.concept: A Brain and Cognition route centred on cognitive neuroscience, perception, higher-order functions, language, biological foundations and quantitative/data-oriented research.
alternatives.distinctness: Neuroscience, life and health sciences, anatomy, physiology and data replace part of the broad psychology mix.
progression: Life-science foundations precede physiology, anatomy and laboratory work, then disease and pathology; cognition, psychology and data courses build from earlier gateways and methods, and every course is offered in its assigned term.

alternatives.label: Psychology, leadership & organisations
alternatives.concept: A Work and Organisational Psychology route centred on organisational behaviour, leadership, diversity, negotiation, workplace wellbeing, behavioural decision-making and applied organisational research.
alternatives.labelReason: The broader label reflects the completed mix of psychology, leadership, organisations, sociology, communication, business and behavioural economics.
alternatives.distinctness: Organisational psychology and leadership replace the biological and cognitive emphasis.
progression: Psychology, business, sociology, methods and leadership foundations precede advanced organisational, communication and behavioural courses.

candidates.label: A Brain and Cognition route centred on cognitive neuroscience, perception, higher-order functions, language, biological foundations and quantitative/data-oriented research.

A Work and Organisational Psychology route centred on organisational behaviour, leadership, diversity, negotiation, workplace wellbeing, behavioural decision-making and applied organisational research.
A clinical-psychology and mental-health direction centred on psychological disorders, diagnosis, assessment and clinically relevant behaviour.
An education-and-development direction centred on development, learning, emotion and educational application.

routeSelection.basis: The generic International Bachelor in Psychology has a broad common core but requires one formal specialisation to instantiate 180 EC. Brain and Cognition most directly continues the common cognitive and biological psychology core rather than selecting an applied specialisation such as Clinical Psychology, Education and Development, or Work and Organisational Psychology. The choice is independent of UCR fit.

selection.assessment: The target has four formal specialisations and UCR can implement two additional evidence-backed routes that are coherent and well beyond the 30-EC distinctness floor: Brain and Cognition and Work and Organisational Psychology.

blocks: Brain and Perception substantially corresponds to UCR Perception & Action, which examines neural mechanisms of perception and action; the comparator was placed only after the canonical UCR rows were fixed.
Memory & Language substantially overlaps UCR Psycholinguistics through language processing, cognition and neurobiological mechanisms; it is the strongest single canonical UCR counterpart.

Data processing and analysis in R is a practical quantitative-data component; UCR Introduction to Data Science is the strongest canonical row for data cleaning, manipulation, visualisation and analysis, while the software environment differs.

UCR offers research-method and evidence-synthesis courses, but no single canonical UCR course substantially reproduces the comparator practical in intervention research without overstating partial overlap.

notes.text: The Erasmus International Bachelor in Psychology provides a structured psychology curriculum with formal specialisations, dedicated psychodiagnostic practicals, psychometrics, a 14-EC thesis and route-specific professional training. UCR can build substantial psychology, cognition and organisational programmes, but it does not reproduce the same accredited disciplinary sequence or specialist practical structure.
